data.name: customSqlQuery1.Sql
data.value: SELECT rank() over(order by items.id,items.name,y.sale_rate) as 'Sr.No',items.id as 'Code',items.name as 'Item',models.name as 'Model',y.sale_rate as 'Sale Rate',i_u.name as 'Unit',items.packing as 'Packing',COALESCE(SUM(y.items_stock_in - (y.items_stock_out + y.returned_quantity)),0) as 'Stock' from items left join item_manufacturers i_m on i_m.id=items.manufacturer_id left join item_groups i_g on i_g.id=items.group_id left join item_categories as i_g_s on i_g_s.id=items.category_id left join item_units as i_u on i_u.id=items.unit_id left join purchase_items as y on items.id=y.item_id left join item_models as models on items.model_id=models.id WHERE y.status='unblocked' and (y.items_stock_in - (y.items_stock_out + y.returned_quantity)) > 0 group by items.id ,items.name,i_u.name,Y.sale_rate,items.packing,models.name
